description: This PHP source file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'WorkShiftStartAndEndTime' used to encapsulate start and end times for a work shift within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes properties for start and end times, constructor, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: WorkShiftStartAndEndTime
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating start and end times for a work shift, using DateTime objects.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing start and end times.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the shift.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the shift.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the shift.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the shift.
